name: Output Completion Check
description: Check distinct completed-record IDs, including empty and malformed output. Run a fictional local demo without an account; optionally send a count-only receipt to Keptick.

parameters.content:
## Output Completion Check
Configure the minimum and ID field, then replace the fictional records or connect a real completed-output node. Keep Always Output Data enabled on the producer so an empty batch reaches the check. The report counts distinct nonempty IDs, invalid IDs and duplicates; it does not prove business correctness. This adaptation includes only the independent local validator.

Original workflow made by Keptick, with AI assistance. No affiliation with n8n. See README for source and license.
